small rituals that make an
ordinary day feel like a film

1. a record on while
the coffee brews

2. getting dressed for nowhere
in particular

3. the long way home,
on purpose

4. one new story a day

a painting, a queen,
a strange fact.

with a real book

6. flowers on your desk
for no reason

7. dinner by candlelight,
even on a tuesday
